title: Cyft intake manifest
description: Written by an adapter alongside the files it collected. This is the entire integration surface: anything that can write this file and some bytes is an adapter. Origin fields are claims by the adapter, recorded as provenance and not treated as verified.

run_id.description: Unique per collection run. A date plus a short source label reads well.

name.description: What produced this. An assistant name, a script name, a person.

source.description: Where the adapter says the material came from. Provenance, not verification.

location.description: Folder path or label. Do not put a credential, token, or signed URL here.

account_hint.description: A non-secret hint such as a masked address, only if it helps the owner tell two accounts apart.

collected_by.description: Human or assistant that ran the collection.

note.description: Free text from the person who ran it. Why this batch, what they were looking for.

path.description: Relative to the manifest. Must not escape the manifest directory.

origin.description: Where this specific file came from: an account handle, a sender, a source URL.

captured.description: When the original was created, if known. Distinct from when it was collected.

group_hint.description: Set when the adapter knows several files came from one post or document. Saves the dedupe stage guessing.

not_retrieved.description: What the adapter could not collect. Reporting a gap is required: a silently shorter list is the failure mode this field exists to prevent.
